Closing it would mean building an actually different screen. ‖ B meets the win condition outright — three visually distinct headers ("Admissible maintenant · 8" green, "À portée · 1" rust, "À explorer · 3" grey, each with a plain-language rule underneath), a why-chip row on every single card ("Ton cégep", "Ta cote R", "Dès la session 2", "Cote min. 32,0 : à 0,8 de ta cote"), and a source domain plus "Vérifié le 24 août 2026" on every figure, with all rows Québec-scoped. Honesty holds up: the counts match the cards actually rendered, missing data is stated rather than faked ("Aucune date limite publiée", "Pas de formulaire en ligne. Contacte les services aux étudiants de ton cégep."), and no copy predicts admission or ranks anything. Two near-misses worth watching: the header chip "TA COTE R 31,20" leans on the word "Ta" and a footer line to prove it is the student's own entry, and the bordered domain boxes ("loranscholar.ca") look tappable next to real "Postuler" pills.
